text: Caught up with Giulia after her knee op. She's been home since Tuesday but can't drive for six weeks, so her husband is doing all the school runs. Remind me to drop some food round Thursday evening.

Ravi got told on Monday that his whole team is at risk of redundancy. Consultation meeting is the 14th at half 10 and he's dreading it. His wife has just gone back to work part time which helps a bit. Should ring him the evening after the meeting.

Long call with Matilda. Her dad passed away on Saturday morning, very peaceful apparently, and her brother Lachlan was with him. Funeral is pencilled in for Friday the 24th at 2pm. She sounded exhausted. Need to sort flowers the day before and ask if she wants a lift. Lachlan is doing the eulogy and is apparently in bits about it. Their mum is coping better than expected.

Zeynep says her manager Ivan is leaving at the end of the month, leaving drinks Thursday at 6. She's been asked to cover his clients until they hire someone and is a bit overwhelmed. Kiara from finance is apparently going for his job too.
Oisín's mum had her hip replacement yesterday morning, all went fine. She's in for three or four nights and then he's taking a week off to look after her. Text him Friday to see how she's getting on.
Mia and her boyfriend split up last weekend, after five years. She's staying at her sister's for now. Seemed okay-ish but kept changing the subject. I'm taking her out for dinner on Saturday.
Andile has his MRI on Wednesday at 8am, then sees the consultant the week after. He's quite nervous, says the waiting is the worst part. Don't forget to message him that morning.
Short one. Yosef's dog Biscuit had surgery on his back leg on Monday, home now with a cone. Yosef hasn't slept much.

Work stuff: Eduardo is moving to the Lisbon office in January, announced at standup today. Lukas is taking over the Popescu account from him and Chen thinks the client won't be happy. Lunch with Eduardo before he goes?
Aditi called. Her grandad's funeral was yesterday, she said it was lovely and loads of people came. She's back at work Monday but going in late. Must check in with her midweek.

Hannah's having her gallbladder out on the 3rd, first thing in the morning. Her partner Eli is taking the day off and her mum is coming the night before to mind the kids. She says all she wants is trashy magazines.
Khadija got the redundancy letter on Friday, two months' notice. She's actually weirdly relieved and wants to retrain as a midwife. Ask her about the course open day.
Dr Shreya Gupta is Mum's new consultant. First appointment Tuesday the 9th at 11.15. Need to take Mum, and park in the multi-storey not the main car park.
Mihai's last chemo session was this morning! Bell ringing and everything. He's got a scan in three months. His wife Teresa said they're going to Cornwall for a week afterwards to celebrate.
Saw Marcus at football. Karim's stag in Prague is off, the venue went bust, so they're doing a pub crawl in town the same weekend instead. Wedding itself is still on for June.

Dalia told me she's been signed off with stress for a month. Her line manager Rhys has been awful to her apparently, constant digs in meetings. Remind me to send her something nice, she loves those fancy candles.
Neha's been in hospital since Sunday night with appendicitis, op went ok on Monday. Visiting is 2 till 4 and 6 till 8. Going with Tanvi tomorrow afternoon.
Yusuf's interview for the senior role is Thursday at 9.30. His boss Divya basically told him it's his to lose, but he's still bricking it. Text him good luck the night before.
Rin and Kiara have broken up. Not totally clear who ended it. Either way the holiday they'd booked for November is off and Rin is trying to get a refund. Check on Rin at the weekend.
Pick up prescription Friday morning, pharmacy shuts at 1 on Saturdays.

Talked to Giulia again. Physio started Monday and the day after she could barely make it to the loo, but it's getting easier. She's bored stiff and binge watching Bake Off. Wants a big jigsaw for her birthday on the 30th. Her sister Dalia is staying with her till the weekend and they're driving each other mad.
Ivan's last day got moved to Wednesday the 29th. Leaving do afterwards at the Crown, about half 5. Zeynep is collecting for a card and present and I said I'd put a tenner in.
Lachlan said the hospice nurses were brilliant with their dad. He and Matilda are clearing the house next month. He's heading back up to Glasgow the day after the funeral.
Weird day. Whole department was told this morning there's going to be a restructure, with announcements on the 18th. Nobody knows anything. Andile reckons support roles go first.
Mrs Williams next door had a fall on Sunday and broke her wrist. Her son is driving down from Leeds tomorrow evening. I should pop over with some milk and bread in the morning.

Chen's been put on a performance improvement plan by his manager. First review is in four weeks. He's gutted and thinks it's because of the Baker fiasco in the summer. Remind me to ask Chen how the first check-in goes.
Coffee with Lukas. He's just moved in with his girlfriend Divya in Walthamstow, still surrounded by boxes. Loves bouldering, goes three times a week. Supports Leicester for some reason.

Eli's dad died on Thursday night, heart attack, totally out of the blue. Eli flies to Tel Aviv tomorrow morning and the funeral is on Sunday. Hannah's staying back with the kids. Must message Eli when he lands, and again a week after. Hannah said he hadn't seen his dad since the summer and feels awful about it. Their eldest keeps asking questions.
Dentist moved to Monday 11th at 4.40. Bring the form.
Teresa says Mihai's scan came back clear!! They're having a little party at theirs on Saturday the 2nd from 7. She said don't bring anything but I'm making a cake anyway.

Divya mentioned in our 1:1 that two people on her team handed in notice this week, Rhys and Tanvi. She's not coping with the workload and is thinking about going part time. Shreya from HR is meeting her Friday at 3pm about it. Honestly she looked wiped out. Her son is starting secondary school next year too, so there's a lot going on.
Oisín (Osh) says his mum is home now. Stitches come out on Thursday and the district nurse is coming the day before to check the wound. He sounded knackered. Ask him if he needs anything picking up.
Kiara's grandmother passed away last month, I had no idea. She's flying to Mumbai on the 15th for the memorial and will be off work two weeks. Should send a card before she goes.
Karim's cat Pepper is having teeth out on Tuesday. He's weirdly anxious about it.

Zeynep found out her pitch to Lopez & Co is Wednesday at 10. She's terrified because Ivan always did them. I'm running through the slides with her Tuesday evening. Message her afterwards to see how it landed.
Rhys's appendix scare turned out to be kidney stones. He's on painkillers and off the rest of the week. Doesn't want visitors, just memes.
Bumped into Yosef and his wife at the station. They've got an IVF appointment on the 21st at half 8 in the morning. Hopeful but nervous. Her sister had twins through the same clinic.
Aditi's got her driving test again on Monday at 1.10. She's failed twice already so fingers crossed. Remind me to text her good luck Monday morning.
Mia's ex has finally moved out, so she's got the flat to herself. She's painting the bedroom this weekend and wants to get a cat. Her mum is visiting from Dublin the week after.

Andile's results are back, consultant says torn meniscus and he needs keyhole surgery sometime in the new year. Relieved it's nothing worse but annoyed he can't play five a side till spring. Ask him about the surgery date once he hears.

Long lunch with the old team, good to see everyone. Matilda is now head of ops at a logistics firm and loves it. Marcus got made redundant in August but walked straight into a job at the council, which he starts on the 4th. Neha is on mat leave, baby girl born in September, called Ava. And Lukas is still on the same project, poor guy, still swearing go-live is definitely before Christmas. We said we'd do this every quarter. I need to send Neha something for the baby and congratulate Marcus properly.
Book the car in for its MOT before the 27th. Also renew the parking permit.
Tanvi was a bit low on the phone. Her divorce was finalised last week and she spent that evening on her own. The kids are with their dad till Sunday. I should invite her round for dinner on Saturday.
Eduardo (Edu to everyone) had his leaving lunch today and the clients sent a massive hamper. He flies to Lisbon on the 6th and starts there the Monday after. Wants us all to visit in the spring.
Chen says the Baker account is up for renewal on the 30th and their CFO is threatening to walk. Big call with them Friday at 2, Karim is leading it. Nobody's slept.
Dalia's operation got cancelled that morning, no beds. She was already gowned up. They've rebooked it for the 12th at 7am. Gutted for her. Call her tomorrow evening.
Khadija's brother Yusuf is getting married in Istanbul in May and she's organising the henna night. Money's tight with the redundancy though. She mentioned she'd love a decent suitcase.

Teresa told me her mum has early dementia, diagnosed over the summer. There's a memory clinic appointment Thursday at 11 and Teresa is going with her. She's finding it really hard. Check in with her Thursday night.

Ravi update. The consultation happened on the 14th and they offered him either a role in Bristol or the package. He's leaning towards the package and taking a few months off, and his wife is fully on board. Ask Ravi what he decides before the end of the month. Also their daughter Rin got into Edinburgh, so they might all move up there eventually.
Hannah's home from hospital! Op went well. She's not allowed to lift anything for a fortnight, so Eli is doing everything and getting a bit frazzled.
Mia Le, the new client lead, wants the deck by Thursday noon and a call the day after at half 9. The Gupta meeting got pushed to next month.

Shreya's partner got laid off on Friday afternoon, by email of all things. She's furious. They've only just bought a house so she's worried about the mortgage. Remind me to send Shreya that recruiter's details.
Voicemail from Uncle Ivan: Auntie's knee surgery is next Tuesday morning and he'll ring afterwards with news. Should call him Wednesday if I haven't heard.

Lachlan (Lachie) is back from Glasgow. Says clearing his dad's house was brutal, they found all the old letters from his mum. He's taken up running to clear his head and wants to do the half marathon in April.
Nice chat with Rin about her pottery class. She's making mugs for everyone for Christmas and is a bit obsessed with glazes now.
Zeynep's pitch went really well, Lopez & Co signed on the spot. Her manager wants her to lead the next one too. She's chuffed.
Kiara's back from Mumbai. The memorial was the day after she landed and the whole family came. Tired but glad she went. She starts a new job at a bank on the 1st. Ask how her first week goes.
Mihai's dad is back in hospital with a chest infection. Mihai's driving up to Leicester tomorrow morning and staying till Sunday, Divya is covering his clients while he's away. Text him Saturday.
Mum's appointment with Dr Murphy went fine, bloods all normal, next check in six months. She wants to go to Madeira in March.
Started the new meds this morning, side effects should settle after a week. Physio Friday at 10.
